findings.title: Include the changed guide in the search-gate impact review
findings.body: This whole A912-04 record previously covers a canonical search index over every reader page, but its changed-bound set names only the asset allowlist. `docs/site/extend/first-plugin.md` is itself a changed canonical reader page, and the added observer text can affect indexed terms and ranking. The proposed preservation therefore omits a material changed input from the independent impact review; add the guide (and assess its generated search output) before preserving this record at the new revision.

overall_explanation: The proposal understates the changed inputs for at least the whole search-gate preservation record, so it cannot support the required independent preservation adjudication as written.
